document: OTP screen intermittently takes 4-5 seconds to load on UAT. Tests that assert OTP input visibility immediately after login can flake — always wait explicitly for the OTP screen before interacting with it.

The Login button's visible label changes momentarily from 'Login' to 'Signing in...' right after click. Selectors based on exact button text can fail transiently — prefer waiting for navigation or a stable attribute instead.
The OTP input field's layout shifts slightly on first render depending on network speed, which has caused a small number of flaky selector failures on the OTP input in past runs.
